description: 原生 repaired-v1 ISSL，固定 2000 SSL + 300 transfer，每 K/N 独立评分，前序其他原生方法排空后启动。
authorization: 用户选择 ISSL 长预算并要求先跑其他方法、正式星地完整 K/N 和自动评分。

data.support_query_ref: C: current new-class support, source replay as method exception, query test only

permissions.claim_scope: exposed development benchmark; repaired native C

checkpoint.initialization: frozen repaired-v1 native source before C

execution.gpu_policy: wait for native C and Tweak queues; GPU0,1,5,6,7; max 7 per GPU; 6000 MiB free
execution.stop_rule: systemic technical/protocol errors stop admissions and drain active; low scores do not stop

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: episodic_score after each fixed K/N task
